name: Matoba Kei
source:
A 33-year-old detective at the First Investigation Division of the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department.
She is an old acquaintance of Nogawa's and is nicknamed "Iron Mask" for her coolness.
Sharp-witted and with a strong sense of justice, she can't tolerate any wrongdoing.
She loathes anything to do with the occult, which is why she's cold towards Nogawa.

[Translated from the [url=https://game.mages.co.jp/shikai/#character]official website[/url]]
